newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks fell by 246,000 barrels in the week ended September 4 to 8.824 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks also fell by 398,000 barrels to 7.025 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks rose by 523,000 barrels to 5.234 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
